class.description: Spin, except that a rover already in contact is allowed to turn. With a circular footprint a rotation about its own centre sweeps no new ground, so Nav2's collision check there is either vacuous or an unconditional veto -- and the veto leaves a rover touching a wall with no way out.
DriveOnHeading, except that a rover already in contact may drive a heading that leads out of the contact. Driving deeper is still refused.
BackUp, on the same terms as EscapeDriveOnHeadingAction: reversing off something is allowed, reversing into it is not.
